title: bug: prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs PowerShell "compact window" rows fail on HEAD 717c4019 (22 of 99 on Windows): the extracted keeper block reads $script:MoeScriptRoot, which 373dc3d4 added and the fixture never sets
description:
Found while planning task-2f22237b, whose DoD needs this suite green through Windows node.exe.

Evidence: a pure `git archive 717c4019` with Windows node.exe, `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` gives 99 tests, 77 pass, 22 fail. All 22 are the `<engine>: <role> <kind> compact window over ...` rows, for both powershell.exe and pwsh.exe. Each fails with "Join-Path : Cannot bind argument to parameter 'Path' because it is null" at `$moeKeeperDir = Join-Path $script:MoeScriptRoot 'mods\moe-compaction-keeper'`.

Cause:
- 373dc3d4 (task-69c02444, still in REVIEW) replaced $PSScriptRoot with $script:MoeScriptRoot in the compaction-keeper and account-switch lines (moe-agent.ps1:10085 and :10092).
- The fixture (prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:406-434) writes the extracted block to <dir>/compact.ps1 and relied on $PSScriptRoot being <dir>.
- This is the same class as f6d9c532 (landed in 717c4019): the heartbeatStop fixture lacked a helper that 373dc3d4 added.

Reach:
- The suite runs in CI's build-all-platforms matrix (step "Test agent runtime discovery"). windows-latest fails, and ubuntu/macos fail too wherever pwsh is installed.
- The WSL env -i gate hides it, because it has no pwsh.

Fix direction: test-only. The PowerShell script prelude in the fixture sets `$script:MoeScriptRoot = $PSScriptRoot`, so the mods paths resolve under <dir> as before. The wrapper and the assertions stay unchanged.
definitionOfDone: scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs exits 0 through Windows node.exe, with every PowerShell compact-window row (powershell.exe and pwsh.exe) passing, and also exits 0 under Linux node.
The diff is the fixture's PowerShell prelude only: scripts/moe-agent.ps1, every assertion and every other row stay byte-identical.
A mutant that drops the new prelude line fails the compact-window rows again on Windows.

implementationPlan.description:
RED evidence, then the one-line fixture fix. The change is test-only, a single line in scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs.

RED first (test-driven-development): before editing, run the Windows half of the step-2 command:
`"/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs`, from the worktree root, in your normal shell, not env -i.
It must show 99 tests, 77 pass, 22 fail. All 22 are '<engine>: <role> <kind> compact window over ...' rows for powershell.exe and pwsh.exe, each with "Join-Path : Cannot bind argument to parameter 'Path' because it is null". Quote it in complete_step. (Planning log: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e54bab27-plan/e54b-win-head.log, a0269bcd.)

The edit. Use an editor tool (Edit on Claude, apply_patch on Codex), not a shell write. The file is LF. At :419 (a0269bcd), in the PowerShell branch's `script = `...`` template, insert `$script:MoeScriptRoot=$PSScriptRoot\n` directly after `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'\n`, so the line begins:
`script = `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'\n$script:MoeScriptRoot=$PSScriptRoot\n$Role='${role}'\n...`
The exact one-line diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e54bab27-plan/e54b-fix.diff. `$script:` and `$PSScriptRoot` contain no `${`, so the template does not interpolate them.

Why this value:
- In the wrapper, $script:MoeScriptRoot is the scripts folder, which holds mods\ (moe-agent.ps1:120). 373dc3d4 moved the keeper and account-switch lines to it (:10085 and :10092 at 717c4019).
- The fixture writes compact.ps1 into <dir>, beside <dir>/mods/..., and its assertions expect keeperDir and switchDir under <dir>. Mapping it to $PSScriptRoot reproduces the wrapper's layout.
- Nothing else changes: not the wrapper, the sh branch, the assertions or the other rows.

No runtime error handling is involved; the fixture only defines a variable the real wrapper always sets. Re-run the Windows command: 99 of 99 pass.
implementationPlan.note: RED on Windows node.exe before the edit: 99 tests, 77 pass, 22 fail (compact-window rows; Join-Path null Path). Added `$script:MoeScriptRoot=$PSScriptRoot` to the fixture prelude (1 insertion/1 deletion on the template line). After: 99 tests, 99 pass, 0 fail.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights: 373dc3d4 (the hot-reload pin) broke two slice-extract fixtures: heartbeatStop (fixed by f6d9c532, landed 717c4019) and this one. Slice fixtures run a wrapper block outside the wrapper, so every script-scope variable the block reads has to be stubbed. The WSL env -i gate skips every pwsh row, so these breaks show only on Windows node.exe, or on CI runners that have pwsh.
planningNotes.risks: (1) Running the Windows leg under env -i loses PATH. Use the normal shell. (2) task-2f22237b dependsOn this row; it lands as soon as this one is DONE. (3) If task-69c02444's QA rejects that row and it changes the keeper lines again, re-check the anchors.
